technique_name: Explain the difference between scientific theory and scientific law.
description: Scientific theories and scientific laws are both used to explain natural phenomena and make predictions about the future behavior of a system. However, they have different meanings and uses. A scientific theory is a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world that is supported by a body of evidence.
